study type: Cross-sectional study and in vitro experiment
outcome: RGC32 mRNA and protein levels in placentas
cohort: Pregnant women with preeclampsia and normal pregnant women from whom term placentas were collected after cesarean section, and HTR8/SVneo trophoblast cells.
finding: RGC32 mRNA and protein levels were significantly downregulated in preeclamptic placentas, and RGC32 silencing inhibited HTR8/SVneo cell migration and invasion, which was associated with decreased MMP-2/9 activities/expression and reduced Akt phosphorylation.
cross-section timing: At term (placentas collected after cesarean section)
